summary: Fable should serve as a bounded perspective specialist for high-ambiguity work, while Sol retains authority and integration.

perspective_result.owner_view_interpretation: The valuable property is not generic model strength but Fable's ability to preserve the owner's abstraction level and unstated tensions while forming a recommendation.
perspective_result.recommended_direction: Use Fable for perspective synthesis and architecture framing, not routine implementation, and require Sol to integrate its proposal.
tensions: More owner context can improve alignment but increases personal-data exposure to the Team account.
uncertainties: The benefit has not yet been measured against owner correction rate on real tasks.
do_not_infer: Do not infer blanket permission to send all personal memory to the Team account.
Do not treat Fable's recommendation as owner approval.
perspective_result.handoff: Pilot Fable on one minimized, read-only ambiguity task; compare correction and clarification against the Sol-only baseline.

verification.check: Trusted Mac wrapper verified Team OAuth and effective model metadata.
Primary confirmed that inferred preferences were not promoted to owner decisions.

uncertainties: This is a contract example and not evidence that the development Mac lane has been deployed.
